description: The true path of the miniature: a bundle tied with a seaman's knot; the sailor at the inn all evening, the parlourmaid who knows no knot but a granny, the groom who learned the knot in the fishing fleet.

moves.see: whoever tied it knew the knot
moves.why: Whoever tied it knew the carrick bend.
Pike knows the knot, but he was at the Bell all evening.
Not Pike: tying it needed him at Fernleigh.
Rudd learned the knot in the fishing fleet.
Rudd knew the knot and was at Fernleigh all evening.
